measurement: ET-8 item 4 — mechanism A (text memory) vs baseline, 7B, 80 tasks
sampling: FOUR DISJOINT 20-TASK SLICES of tasks/v1 (1-20, 21-40, 41-60, 61-80). et8_agent generates at temp 0.0 with no seed argument, so a re-run is byte-identical — slices are how this gets independent samples, and they are slices, NOT sampling seeds.
result: MECHANISM A IS DESTRUCTIVE AT 7B: 20.0% against the baseline's 62.5%, and the gap is larger than the between-slice spread of either arm (baseline 55-70, memA 10-40).

mechanism.what_the_memory_does: steps rise 525 -> 819 and the rise is almost ALL noop_patch: 231 -> 532. The model re-emits code it was shown instead of editing it. hypothesize is identical (80 = one per episode), so the memory is not changing WHERE it looks — it is changing what it does after.
mechanism.and_this_was_already_on_the_record: results/memA_v0_plumbing_3b.json (09-05, 3B, n=20) found the same thing and named it: 'the dominant waste is noop_patch (107/204): the model re-emits the shown code'. That run called itself a PLUMBING TEST because the lessons were distilled from the same 20 tasks. This run is 80 DIFFERENT tasks at 7B and reproduces the failure mode, which turns a plumbing caveat into a result.

the_artifact_is_the_problem_not_the_carr.lessons.txt: 1,662 bytes, 30 lines, distilled from 40 episodes of v03_3b + v03_7b whose own green rate was 15/40 = 37.5%
the_artifact_is_the_problem_not_the_carr.reading: The memory teaches a 37.5% policy to a 60% model. Six of its ten clusters say 'no winning start recorded yet'. It is advice distilled from a WEAKER run than the one consuming it.

not_claimed: That text memory cannot work. This is ONE artifact — v0 lessons — and it is demonstrably weaker than the model reading it. A memory distilled from the 7B's own 1,197 green episodes is untested.
A mechanism for noop_patch. I can show it dominates and that it more than doubles under A; I cannot say why the lessons induce it.
Anything about mechanism C — its arm is re-running now with corrected 7B vectors.
Anything about mechanism F — it is not defined in the proposal or the code and I asked Ri to name it.
